environment.description: Same container image deployed on hardened k8s cluster. Pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container's entrypoint is overridden to run via a wrapper that sets FEEDBACK_STORAGE and FEEDBACK_OUTPUT to paths under /var/lib and /var/www respectively, but since the entire rootfs including those paths is mounted read-only with no overlay tmpfs, all write(2) syscalls to any path return EROFS. The kubelet enforces this at the container runtime (containerd) level via OCI spec readonly rootfs flag. Additionally, the pod has no ephemeral storage claims.

config.volumes: none - no PVC, emptyDir, hostPath, or configMap volumes mounted as writable
config.note: OCI runtime spec sets rootfs readonly flag at runc/containerd level
